item.title: Washington Post cuts a third of its staff in a blow to a legendary news brand
item.description: The Washington Post laid off one-third of its staff Wednesday, eliminating its sports section, several foreign bureaus and its books coverage in a widespread purge that represented a brutal blow to journalism and one of its most legendary brands.
